# The hosted-CI carrier of P05.3 moves to P05.4

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D88.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-10-03

## Status

accepted

## Decision

The hosted-CI Validation bullet (D73 п.4, D76) is removed from the P05.3 spec. Hosted CI is verified once by the P05.4 carrier on the final commit of phase P05, which contains the P05.3 commit `a59c38b2`; the owner configures hosted CI after P05.4. Every other P05.3 carrier, the review result, the empty allowlist and the Impersonation-only baseline stay binding. The spec edit changes the design fingerprint, so this decision carries a `design-audit-waiver/v1` for the new fingerprint and replaces D86 in `@plan/plan.json`; no repeated whole-plan design audit is assigned (the change is one deleted bullet, routes, order and review are unchanged).

## Rationale

The owner postponed the hosted-CI setup and asked to unblock P05.4, which depends on P05.3 GREEN; closing on a missing carrier is forbidden by plan-lint (D76), so the carrier has to move rather than be skipped.

## D88 — The hosted-CI carrier of P05.3 moves to P05.4

**Actor:** repository owner; запись executor/claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5/high.
**Evidence:** `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-P05.3-execution-owner-direction-d88.json` (sha256 `a34d37a6b20b717626e3d01b5b917edb0092c71293c202c20b5e3281f64f0d93`) — verbatim owner messages and the chosen option; RAG:—.

## Solution

The hosted-CI Validation bullet (D73 п.4, D76) is removed from the P05.3 spec. Hosted CI is verified once by the P05.4 carrier on the final commit of phase P05, which contains the P05.3 commit `a59c38b2`; the owner configures hosted CI after P05.4. Every other P05.3 carrier, the review result, the empty allowlist and the Impersonation-only baseline stay binding. The spec edit changes the design fingerprint, so this decision carries a `design-audit-waiver/v1` for the new fingerprint and replaces D86 in `@plan/plan.json`; no repeated whole-plan design audit is assigned (the change is one deleted bullet, routes, order and review are unchanged).

## Why

The owner postponed the hosted-CI setup and asked to unblock P05.4, which depends on P05.3 GREEN; closing on a missing carrier is forbidden by plan-lint (D76), so the carrier has to move rather than be skipped.

## Consequences

P05.3 closes GREEN on its local Validation and review evidence; D87 is superseded. A red hosted job found after P05.4 is repaired by the P05.4 session or the owner. The D86 waiver no longer applies to the current fingerprint.
